data.one_liner: Easily add staggered animations to ListView, GridView, Column and Row children.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility widgets and configuration classes to sequence entry animations for list and grid items. Supports fade, slide, scale, and flip effects.
use_when: You want items in a ListView or GridView to animate sequentially when they appear.
You need standard Material Design motion sequencing on columns or rows.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based or gesture-driven animations.
You are building animations that are not item collections.
strengths: Simple API with built-in support for lists, grids, rows, and columns.
Includes an AnimationLimiter to prevent re-animating already displayed items during scroll.
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-defined animation types (fade, slide, scale, flip).
